title: How to Build a Flexible Maternity + Postpartum Wardrobe
summary: Whether you're dressing a growing bump, navigating postpartum changes or redefining your style altogether, the right pieces can help you feel like yourself through it all. A Stitch Fix Stylist can help you find them. Take a look.
body_markdown:
Pregnancy and early motherhood bring constant change, but getting dressed doesn’t have to mean forfeiting your personal style. Instead, this chapter can be an opportunity to[build a wardrobe that moves with you](https://www.stitchfix.com/women/maternity) .


By focusing on comfortable foundations, adaptable silhouettes and versatile layers, you can create outfits that support your changing body while helping you feel confident through every stage of early motherhood.


## **The Art of Fit Flexibility**


The[best maternity wardrobes aren’t always the biggest](https://www.stitchfix.com/women/blog/style-guide/maternity-style-wardrobe/) . They’re thoughtfully curated collections of pieces that work together, adapt to change and make getting dressed feel effortless.


Rather than hiding a changing shape, embrace pieces designed to move with you. Foundational essentials such as knit tops, soft tanks, leggings and dresses create a versatile starting point throughout pregnancy and beyond.


A few well-chosen layering pieces can add polish and versatility throughout pregnancy (and after!). These hero pieces can add polish while helping your wardrobe adapt as your needs change.


> “Structured open-front blazers and elongated cardigans are maternity wardrobe workhorses. They instantly elevate simple foundations like a fitted tee, tank or maternity dress while creating a streamlined silhouette.”
> – Stylist Julie


## **Postpartum Style Evolution**


The postpartum period often brings new style needs as your body and routine continue to evolve.


Rather than focusing on returning to a previous size, give yourself grace during this in-between chapter. Focus on discovering what helps you feel comfortable, confident and like yourself today.


> “Postpartum style is all about meeting your body where it is today. Reach for flexible silhouettes like relaxed trousers, wrap styles, easy dresses and soft knits that adapt as your shape continues to change.”
> – Stylist Caro


Styles with elastic waistbands, wrap closures, fluid cuts and premium stretch fabrics can offer comfort without feeling restrictive.


> “A few pieces that fit and feel good right now can make getting dressed easier while giving you the freedom to rediscover what feels like you.”
> – Stylist Caro


It can also be an opportunity to explore silhouettes and fabrics that better fit your lifestyle today. For many parents, changing routines naturally influence what feels comfortable, practical and personal.


> “As a mother of four, I quickly discovered relaxed silhouettes and found myself focusing on breathable fabrics. Holding babies warms you up very quickly. I looked for tops with unique detailing to still feel like myself while keeping up with real life.”
> – Stylist Erin


You don’t have to navigate those shifts alone. A Stitch Fix Stylist can provide personalized recommendations tailored to your fit preferences, lifestyle and evolving needs.


## **[Stitch Fix X ThredUp: Create Space for What’s Next](https://stitchfix.thredup.com/)**


Sometimes the biggest wardrobe upgrade is making space for what no longer serves you. A closet filled with pieces from past chapters can make getting dressed feel unnecessarily complicated.


Through Stitch Fix’s Closet Reset partnership with ThredUp, clients can send in eligible clothing through a Clean Out Kit and potentially earn Stitch Fix credit toward future purchases.


Think of it as a circular wardrobe loop:


**Clean Out → Earn Credit → Refresh → Re-enter**


It’s a simple way to create room for pieces that better fit your life today while helping keep great clothes in circulation.
